create.name: Flying Cloud Zen
create.bio:
Flying Cloud Zen is a small Soto Zen community from the Twin Cities area of Minnesota that now meets mostly online. Its guiding teacher, Rev. Busshō Lahn, came to Soto Zen in 1993, was ordained in 2009, received Dharma transmission in 2015 and served for over a decade on the priest staff of Minnesota Zen Meditation Center; he is also a spiritual director and published his first book of Zen teaching in 2023. After many years based at the Aslan Institute in Eagan, the community is looking for a new home and in the meantime gathers on Zoom.

It describes its style as humble and down to earth, rooted in Zen but open to wisdom from other faith traditions. Short drop-in sittings run at sunrise and sunset twice a week, with a Saturday morning sitting and conversation, a monthly Dharma talk, a book group and a monthly half-day mindfulness group with teaching and exercises. Classes and retreats run through the year, members can follow a traditional path towards lay initiation or ordination, and one-to-one spiritual direction is offered. Regular sittings are by donation, and recorded talks and practice handouts are shared freely.

courses.title: Drop-in Zen Sittings (Zoom)
courses.description: Half-hour sunrise and sunset sittings on Tuesdays and Thursdays, each ending with an optional sutra chant, plus a Saturday morning sitting followed by chanting and open conversation about practice. No registration; donations welcome.

courses.title: Monthly Mindfulness Practice Group
courses.description: A Saturday morning gathering on Zoom once a month that mixes sitting, a teaching theme, reflective exercises and group discussion in a lightly Zen, mostly secular style. Each session is recorded for participants.

courses.title: Spiritual Direction
courses.description: One-to-one spiritual companioning, held privately on Zoom, for people wanting to explore their spiritual life, discern choices and bring their practice into daily life. Open to people of any faith or none.

courses.title: Traditional Practice Path
courses.description: For committed members, a path within the Soto Zen tradition towards formal lay initiation (jukai) and, for some, ordination and priest training, worked out with the teacher over several years.

free_resources.title: Practice Handouts
free_resources.description: Free PDFs of the chants and texts used in practice, including the Heart Sutra, the Metta Sutta and Dogen's Fukanzazengi, with simple instructions for zazen, breath and walking meditation and aids for noticing emotions and needs.
